metadata.title: Coca-Cola Stock Could Lose Its Fizz. Its Valuation Is the Highest in 25 Years.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Coca-Cola Stock Could Lose Its Fizz. Its Valuation Is the Highest in 25 Years.
If there’s a bubble in the stock market now, it isn’t in technology but rather in consumer staples. Coca-Cola is the prime example.
